about_the_game:
What happens when a simple trick goes too far?

In Accidental Hypnosis, you find yourself face-to-face with Rinka, a girl from your past who was once just a teasing memory. But when an old coin unlocks something deep inside her, what starts as a playful experiment turns into something much more intense.

As the night unfolds, the line between control and submission blurs. Will you guide her back to reality, or let her sink even deeper?

Features:

  • Fully Animated 2D Visual Novel – Every scene comes to life with smooth, handcrafted animations.

  • Multiple Routes & Endings – Your choices shape Rinka’s fate… and your own.

  • Immersive Storytelling – A blend of psychological tension, dark humor, and undeniable intimacy.

  • High-Quality Art & Sound – Crafted with stunning detail and a custom soundtrack.

This isn’t just a story about hypnosis—it’s about what happens when you push someone too far… and what waits for you on the other side.
